label: Different Voices When a Husband Chooses His Wife’s Last Name

tier_table.sentence: Here are the voices of three people with different situations and lives.
First is a father who was adopted into his wife’s family and took their last name.
First is a father who was adopted into his wife’s family and took their last name.

tier_table.tv_ja: find it + 形容詞 + that節では、itを形式目的語、that節を内容を示す節として読む。
tier_table.sentence: Living at my wife’s parents’ home, I still find it a little hard that I have so little time to myself.

tier_table.tv_ja: 動名詞句が主語になる文では、句全体の終わりを見つけてから主節の動詞を特定する。
tier_table.sentence: But fitting in with each family’s idea of what is normal was harder than changing my last name.
Once I could accept that it was normal for things to be different, I felt much more at ease.
Next is a mother whose son is getting married next year.
Next is a mother whose son is getting married next year.

tier_table.tv_ja: 長い文頭節に埋め込み節がある場合、コンマの後で主節の主語と動詞を探す。
tier_table.sentence: When I heard that my son, who is getting married next year, would take his bride’s last name, I didn’t like it.

tier_table.tv_ja: 疑問文のit-cleftでは、it is/was X that ...の形から強調される要素Xを見つける。
tier_table.sentence: But was it only the change of last name that I didn’t like?

tier_table.tv_ja: What節が主語になる疑似分裂文では、what節を「私が感じていたこと」というまとまりで読む。
tier_table.sentence: I think what I really felt was that I wanted him to stay close.
Last is someone from the parents’ generation whose relative chose his wife’s last name.
Last is someone from the parents’ generation whose relative chose his wife’s last name.
The relative’s mother, my aunt, was so shocked that she became ill.

tier_table.tv_ja: 名詞に関係節が続く主語では、関係節の終わりを見極めて主節の動詞を特定する。
tier_table.sentence: The man who was adopted into his wife’s family says he was grateful that both his parents and his wife’s parents accepted his decision.

tier_table.tv_ja: 関係節を含む長い主語では、関係節が終わる位置を確認して主節の動詞を探す。
tier_table.sentence: The parent who says they don’t want to hold their son back wanted his partner’s parents to be grateful to their son.

tier_table.tv_ja: 長い句がandで並列されて主語になる場合は、並列全体の終わりを確かめてから動詞を探す。
tier_table.sentence: Thanks for accepting his decision and thanks for changing his last name go in opposite directions.
